data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to receive incoming shared text, files, and media from other apps.
data.what_it_does: Enables Flutter applications to handle incoming shared content such as text, URLs, images, and videos from the system share sheet on iOS and Android. It also provides APIs to record conversations to populate direct share suggestions and shortcuts.
use_when: Your app needs to receive text, links, or files shared from other applications via the native share sheet
You want to support direct sharing into specific conversation targets or shortcuts
avoid_when: You only need to trigger outgoing shares to other apps (use an outgoing share package instead)
Desktop or web platforms are required, as it only supports Android and iOS
strengths: Supports both initial shared media when launched and real-time streaming updates when running
Provides built-in integration for iOS Share Extensions and Android direct share targets
Handles multiple media types including images, videos, URLs, text, and documents
weaknesses: Requires extensive native iOS and Android configuration including creating an iOS Share Extension and App Groups
No support for desktop or web platforms
data.setup_notes: Requires extensive native setup: creating an iOS Share Extension target, configuring App Groups and URL schemes in Info.plist, adjusting Podfiles, and defining intent filters and shortcut XML in Android.
